Method of Attack: Exploited zero-day CVE-2021-20016 in SonicWall SMA 100 Series VPN appliances to deploy ransomware; Uses Windows Restart Manager to close files in use for encryption; Uses different embedded encryption libraries, memory-only dropper, and asynchronous I/O requests
Impacted Systems: Networks of North American and European targets
Attack Vector: Exploitation of zero-day vulnerability CVE-2021-20016; Use of Cobalt Strike implants for persistence; Backdoor installation via SombRAT variant
